items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Shows like, when I had Pig Meat Markham. I used to do certain acts with them.

ctx.x: And make a lot of people feel good.
Yeah. We had fun. Shows like, when I had Pig Meat Markham. I used to do certain acts with them. I wouldn't miss standing on the side of the curtain just listening to those comedians perform.
If you'd just finish that sentence where you were talking about, what, Pig Meat, then we'll stop cause we don't want to get you too close.
